name: Liwyrm
dexEntry: These small and strange looking Pokémon are very commonly found in the region of Lumora. Many mistake them for tiny dragons, which lead to its nickname 'Dragonhead'. Their green skin helps them camouflage amongst the leafage of trees. If they do get spotted by a Flying type Pokémon, Liwyrm will rear up and flail with all four of its tiny arms. Surprisingly this strategy scares off a majority of its predators. If this didn't scare them, Liwyrm use its spiny and poisonous tail, leaving its opponent with a terrible sting.
